review_candidates.description_excerpt: SRI is seeking an experienced Systems Administrator to support secure research programs at our Ann Arbor, Michigan facility. This position focuses primarily on Linux systems administration, with additional responsibilities supporting Windows environments, security compliance, and specialized scientific computing infrastructure. Responsibilities Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Linux servers, workstations, and specialized scientific computing environments. Administer Windows servers
eligibility_evidence: The position will work onsite at our Ann Arbor office.
5+ years of systems administration experience US Citizen with a current active Top Secret security clearance and eligibility for Special Access Program (SAP) access.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Provide hands-on technical support for researchers and engineers working in secure and classified computing environments. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of systems administration experience US Citizen with a current active Top Secret security clearance and eligibility for Special Access Program (SAP) access. Familiarity with DISA STIGs, system hardening, and government security compliance requirements. Knowledge of NISPOM, Risk Management Framework (RMF), and NIST security requirements.
